QUOTE: "`scope.not_indexed` lists extensions that were never read: `.rs=2`, `.toml=2`, `.csv=3`, `.sql=1`, `.lock=1`, `.jsonl=1`, `.motor=1`, and 3 extensionless files. A miss in those is "never looked," not "absent,""
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names file types that were NOT indexed (never read), whereas the item requires naming file types that WERE in scope and produced no rows. The answer does state the distinction between "never looked" and "absent", but not the in-scope-yet-empty file types.
